name: Dead Bug
summary: A floor exercise that trains the abs to keep the lower back steady while the arms and legs move.
setup: Lie on your back with the arms pointing to the ceiling and hips and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press the lower back gently toward the floor and brace the abs.
execution: Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Stop before the lower back lifts off the floor.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat on the other side while breathing steadily.
mistakes: Arching the lower back: shorten the range of motion.
Moving too fast: slow the tempo.
Holding the breath: exhale as you extend.
Flaring the ribs: keep them drawn down.
